entries.source: SDK 16.4 and 26.2 PHASE.framework PHASEDistanceModel.h and PHASEEnvelope.h, byte-identical on the members; PHASE arrived in iOS 15 and the port's releases are 6.1.3 and 4.3, so there is no PHASE.framework on either and there is no PHASEDistanceModel to convert: what is carried is the holding of an envelope, whose x the header calls distance and whose y it calls gain, compared against the host's own PHASEEnvelopeDistanceModelParameters and the gain both report at 5 m in tests/backports/host/phase/run.sh
entries.reason: PHASEDistanceModel.h marks -init and +new NS_UNAVAILABLE and -initWithEnvelope: is its NS_DESIGNATED_INITIALIZER; a distance model with no envelope is not a distance model
entries.effect: calling it raises, which is what unavailable means; -initWithEnvelope: is the way to make one
